CustomObject.description: US-20194: one field used by a PMT team at a PMT stage (child of PMTFieldRule__mdt, replaces its 4 line-per-field lists). Requirement says whether the team must fill it; Condition (formula on ProjectProduct__c / ProjectShareclass__c fields) says when the team uses it, empty = always. Read through the PMTMatrix Apex class.
CustomObject.label: PMT - Field Rule Line
